9590f767-b0f8-46fc-9fae-cb01379ba884.data: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.
9590f767-b0f8-46fc-9fae-cb01379ba884.text_lemmatized: Mitosis has five phases: Interphase, Prophase, Metaphase, Anaphase, and Telophase.

0926a02e-5011-4d1c-80c2-485ec610e2b9.data: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.
0926a02e-5011-4d1c-80c2-485ec610e2b9.text_lemmatized: During Interphase, the DNA in the cell is copied in preparation for cell division, resulting in two identical complete sets of chromosomes.

09e65d44-9963-42a7-855c-2afda6a44519.data: In Prophase, the chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.
09e65d44-9963-42a7-855c-2afda6a44519.text_lemmatized: In Prophase, the chromosomes condense into X-shaped structures that can be easily seen under a microscope, and the membrane around the nucleus dissolves away releasing the chromosomes.

776b8e90-6dc5-41ad-af62-79c7e0a3b266.data: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.
776b8e90-6dc5-41ad-af62-79c7e0a3b266.text_lemmatized: During Metaphase, the chromosomes line up neatly end-to-end along the center of the cell, and the mitotic spindle fibers attach to each of the sister chromatids.

82778326-449d-483f-b19b-1c5a4d54f189.data: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid going to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.
82778326-449d-483f-b19b-1c5a4d54f189.text_lemmatized: In Anaphase, the sister chromatids are pulled apart by the mitotic spindle, with one chromatid going to one pole and the other chromatid to the opposite pole.

3014f78e-f607-43c8-80dd-a4f16c78d488.data: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
3014f78e-f607-43c8-80dd-a4f16c78d488.text_lemmatized: In Telophase, a full set of chromosomes gather together at each pole of the cell, and a membrane forms around each set of chromosomes to create two new nuclei.
